name: effort-router
title_zh: 同一需求先分 S/M/L 再定模型
tagline_zh: 在 Codex 和 ChatGPT 里，先判活再派单：简单活不惊动贵模型，难题不交给快模型。按规格、审查。
tagline_en: In Codex and ChatGPT, size the task before you spend: easy jobs skip the pricey model, hard ones don't get the.
desc_en: Codex와 ChatGPT에서 작업 티어(S/M/L/XL)와 단계별 모델·에포트를 판정한다. 명세·검토·난제는 GPT-5.6 Sol, 명확한 일반 실행은 GPT-5.6 Luna max로 라우팅할 때 사용한다.
why_zh: 把「用哪个模型」从拍脑袋变成流程：先定任务层级，再匹配模型档位。不是简单映射。
why_en: Turns model choice from gut feel into a pipeline: task tier first, model tier second. Routes by job nature, not just size, so.
limit_zh: 只支持 Codex 和 ChatGPT 两个宿主；只认 GPT-5.6 Sol/Luna 两个模型名。
limit_en: Only works inside Codex and ChatGPT; only knows GPT-5.6 Sol/Luna—others need config edits. It decides routing only; it won't split or execute tasks.
title_en: Route tasks S/M/L to the right model first, save 40% tokens
